tool_args.rationale: The history gap and transient lag favor the coupled memory ODE. The fine trajectory batch targets the transient shape needed to distinguish how quickly memory evolves from how strongly it affects the forecast.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter coupled ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint targets at similar horizons provide little redundancy, and every initial memory state must be reconstructed using the same unknown time constant being fitted.
It costs less, but the main uncertainty is how to separate the memory timescale from its coupling strength within the leading mechanism, not which coarse model family to pursue.
Neither law carries the history state needed to explain the reported endpoint-matched history gap.
